auto save. the way it works:

i just started the program -> i go to the route -> its on 'new' right away. i click on add and get a mesh -> i see this as 'new scene' or whatever on the side -> i click the name twice -> i can change the name of it -> hot reloads come thru -> i was last on scene_id_whatever, persist it -> every update on this scene persists to a branch, every camera movement persists to a twig. we dont care about keeping camera on restarts. we care about it on hot reloads. same for tools. we dont care about if it was face edge or vertex on fresh starts. we do care on hot reloads. this is very important to nail. i drag a face, i make a loop cut, i do ANYTHING, that is a branch save. i move my camera, i select a different tool, these are twig saves, they only matter during the time of working, we dont restore this state on a brand new load though. 

very key because undo history only is applicable to branches. twigs do NOT follow undo at all
